source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
This ability has 2 parts:

- When declaring a charge with an enemy **CHARACTER** unit no more than 12" away from this unit, you may use this part. Doing so lets this unit re-roll the **Charge roll**, but its **charge move** must finish **engaged** with at least one such enemy **CHARACTER** unit.
- Once per battle for your army, during the Fight phase, as this unit gets **selected to fight** while a **CHARACTER** unit is engaged with it, you may use this part. If you do, its melee attacks gain **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds)** for the rest of that phase.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

when.event: this unit is selected to fight

parts.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: the official text prints no duration, so the effect lasts only for the phase it was applied in.
